    input wire rst,

);

                        mem_array[index] <= 1'b0; // Deallocate the block

                end
                3'b010: begin // status
                    mem_status <= mem_array; // Output the memory status
                end
                default: begin

description:
Design a Parallel-in Serial-out (PISO) shift register with the following specifications:
- It should accept an 8-bit parallel input.
- It should shift the bits out serially on a clock signal.
- A load signal should be used to load new data into the register.
- An output signal should indicate when the shifting is complete.
code:
module PISO (
    input wire clk,
    input wire load,
    input wire [7:0] parallel_in,
    output reg serial_out,
    output reg done
);
    reg [7:0] shift_reg;
    reg [2:0] count;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            shift_reg <= parallel_in; // Load data
            count <= 3'b000;          // Reset count
            done <= 1'b0;             // Not done yet
        end else if (count < 3'b111) begin
            serial_out <= shift_reg[7]; // Shift out the MSB
            shift_reg <= {shift_reg[6:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left
            count <= count + 1;         // Increment count
        end else begin
            serial_out <= shift_reg[7]; // Shift out the last bit
            done <= 1'b1;                // Indicate done
        end
    end
endmodule

    input wire allocate,        // Allocate signal
    input wire free,           // Free signal
    output reg success,        // Success flag
    output reg [7:0] memory   // Memory status (1 = allocated, 0 = free)
);

            memory <= 8'b00000000; // Reset memory to free
            success <= 0;

                if (memory[req_size] == 0) begin
                    memory[req_size] <= 1; // Allocate memory
                    success <= 1;
                end else begin
                    success <= 0; // Allocation failed
                end
            end else if (free) begin
                if (memory[req_size] == 1) begin
                    memory[req_size] <= 0; // Free memory
                    success <= 1;
                end else begin
                    success <= 0; // Free failed
                end
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

    input rst,
    input signed [15:0] z, // Measurement

);

    reg signed [15:0] P; // Estimate error covariance

    input wire stop,
    output reg SDA,

);

        endcase
    end
